content.name: Scholar
entries: While studying magic, you also specialized in another field of study. Choose one of the following skills in which you have proficiency: {@skill Arcana|SRD52}, {@skill History|SRD52}, {@skill Investigation|SRD52}, {@skill Medicine|SRD52}, {@skill Nature|SRD52}, or {@skill Religion|SRD52}. You have {@variantrule Expertise|SRD52} in the chosen skill.
